# Gift Up!

Gift Up! is a digital platform that allows businesses to sell, manage, and redeem gift cards online, integrating seamlessly with websites and apps to streamline gift card transactions and promotions.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gift-up/.

## Actions

- **Get Checkout Settings** (read-only): Retrieve the current checkout settings.
- **Get Company Details** (read-only): Retrieve company details.
- **List Gift Cards** (read-only): List gift cards.
- **List GiftUp Users** (read-only): List all users.
- **List Item Groups** (read-only): List item groups.
- **List Items** (read-only): List items.
- **List Locations** (read-only): List all locations.
- **List Report Transactions** (read-only): List report transactions with optional filters.
- **Subscribe to Webhook**: Subscribe to a Gift Up!
